run_id: <uuid — the same id as in hw-results.json>
$purpose: Pins everything that would change the number, so the run can be repeated. If a field here is wrong, hw-results.json describes a measurement nobody can reproduce.

harness.infrastructure: <the benchmark job or runner that produced this>

environment.container_image: <image and digest, or null for bare metal>

env_vars.<VAR>: <value that affects the result, e.g. thread or device selection>

system_state.numa_binding: <how the run was pinned, or null>

workload.name: <what is being run>
workload.model_source: <URL or internal path, with a version or digest>
workload.dataset: <name and version, or synthetic input description>

no_skill.code: <path or gist of the agent's code without the skill>

with_skill.code: <path or gist of the agent's code with the skill>
